summary: Document the BUG-0094 Core pool-membership/repository reconciliation contract and BUG-0095 transient Core storage discovery contract. API impact: changed Core protocol and new local/client routes; Controller remains a transient relay and inventory projection only.

guide.reason: Adds the local authenticated pool-join procedure and explains master-owned NFS/SMB member access, while retaining local/single-writer OpenZFS and iSCSI limits.

api.reason: Documents authenticated local pool joining, Core-to-Core membership/repository reconciliation, capability-gated discovery, report request/response messages, validation, failure and cancellation boundaries.

roadmap.reason: The API reference does not change published roadmap status.

state.reason: Pool membership, master-owned repository configuration and per-member observations are Core state; discovery is transient and creates no durable state.
state.record: The pool master retains pool-peer membership/offer/replay state and pool-storage desired records, member access observations, reservations and mutation markers under its agent state; a member retains its pending rehome, peer identity, member-scoped SMB receipt when applicable, and normal managed-storage journal entry. A replacement Controller adopts membership, repository and access observations from authenticated Core inventory. Discovery requests, results and relay credentials are deleted after the bounded exchange and are not durable.
